CHAPTER.VERS: I will extol you, O ,because you have lifted me up,and not suffered my foes to rejoice over me.
I cried to you for help,O my God, and you healed me.
You have brought me up, , from Sheol,from my way to the pit back to life you have called me.
Sing praise to the , faithful people;give thanks to his holy name.
For his anger lasts only a moment,his favour endures for a lifetime.Weeping may lodge for the night,but the morning brings shouts of joy.
When all went well, I imaginedthat never should I be shaken.
For by your favour, O ,you had set me on mountains strong:but you hide your face,and I was confounded.
Then to you, , I cried,to the I begged for mercy,
“What profit is there in my blood,if I go down to the pit?Can you be praised by dust?Can it tell of your faithfulness?
Hear, , and show me your favour, be a helper to me.”
You have turned my mourning to dancing;my sackcloth you have unloosed,and clothed me with joy:that unceasingly I should sing your praise,and give thanks to you, my God, forever.
